title: 10 May 2012: Paul McCartney live at Zócalo de la Ciudad de México, Mexico City, Mexico
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Zócalo de la Ciudad de México in Mexico City, Mexico, on 10 May 2012.

It was the 32nd show of the On The Run Tour, which lasted for 37 dates between July 2011 and November 2012, and the last of three Mexican shows.

This was a free event. The Zócalo is the main plaza in the historic center of Mexico City. Its formal name is Plaza de la Constitución (Constitution Square), and has been a gathering place for Mexicans since Aztec times.

Ahead of the show the city authorities announced that 80,000 people would be admitted inside the Zócalo, while seven giant screens were erected on nearby streets to allow an estimated 150,000 more to watch.

‘Every Night’ always seems to bring me back to a time and place, so much so that I still want to touch it. Let me explain. I have this memory of a time when it actually was in the set, and there’s this one show that really stands out. It was a free concert we played to 400,000 people at a place called the Zócalo in Mexico City. These days audiences in America and Britain don’t have cigarette lighters, which is a good thing, I think. They don’t smoke, at least cigarettes that is, as much as they used to. If they want to send us a signal, they use their phones. In the old days, it used to be cigarette lighters. And in Mexico it still is. Those fans know how to have fun. So there were 400,000 people out there in the dark. When we sang ‘Every Night’, I noticed they’d switch on their cigarette lighters. Every time I’m singing ‘Oo, oo, oo …’ with 400,000 people flicking their lighters, you can hear it. It’s not just a visual thing, it’s a rhythm. And I remember stopping, I thought it was so cool. They were keeping great time. So, I would just sing, ‘But tonight I just want to stay in / And be with you’, stop. And you could hear the flint going as the flame appeared. So, it would be the flame on the offbeat, flame, flame, and flame to the sound of 400,000 flints. It was and will always be magical.
Paul McCartney
The Lyrics: 1956 To The Present

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
